label: CFTR modulators
description: Small-molecule potentiators correctors amplifiers or stabilizers acting on CFTR protein

label: Nonsense readthrough
description: Agents intended to override premature stop codons in CFTR

label: Genetic therapy
description: Parent class for nucleic-acid and gene-targeted CFTR restoration

label: CFTR mRNA
description: Delivery of CFTR-encoded mRNA to produce protein independent of genotype

label: Gene replacement
description: Delivery of a functional CFTR coding sequence

label: Gene editing
description: Editing or inserting sequence at CFTR including prime editing

label: Antisense / splicing oligonucleotides
description: Oligonucleotides that alter CFTR RNA processing

label: Mucociliary clearance
description: Hydrators mucolytics ENaC inhibitors and related airway-surface approaches

label: Anti-inflammatory
description: Agents targeting airway inflammation independent of CFTR restoration

label: Antimicrobial
description: Small-molecule or biologic antibacterials including inhaled antibiotics

label: Antifungal
description: Agents for fungal or mixed infection including aspergillus-targeted drugs

label: Metabolic / CFRD
description: Glucose regulation and other metabolic interventions in CF

label: GI and nutrition
description: PERT bile acid GI motility liver and nutritional interventions

label: Care delivery / digital / behavioral
description: Adherence monitoring adult care coordination and related non-drug interventions

label: CFTR-independent anion transport
description: Ionophores or other approaches that restore airway anion transport without repairing CFTR protein

label: Diagnostic / biomarker / imaging
description: Sweat testing imaging and biomarker studies rather than therapeutic candidates

label: Other
description: Does not fit the taxonomy or is insufficiently described
